purpose: Synthetic known-answer cases for city-level change impact, evidence applicability and selective requalification.
normative_notice: Every node, revision, digest, timestamp, event, edge and claim is synthetic. No fixture represents real engineering, legal, supplier, asset, district or operating data.
precedence: An untrusted event cannot invalidate or supersede a claim; it produces insufficient_evidence when the change authority is required.
A qualified impact path creates revalidation_required unless an exact post-change revalidation receipt discharges that claim.
An authoritative revocation or invalid input produces invalid_evidence for exact dependent claims.
not_affected requires qualified complete coverage of the declared dependency scope; missing edges or excluded domains produce insufficient_evidence.
Late-arriving events preserve prior historical knowledge views while affecting present reliance when applicable.
No status grants action, release, professional or operational authority.
